Definition: to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to grow strong, be hardened; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to grow strong, be hardened; 1a2) to grow arrogant (fig); 1b) (Pael) to make strong, make firm, make stringent
